info.name: YRP
info.description:
Yaro Perfumes API (Express `/api`).

**BASE_URL** must include `/api` (e.g. `http://80.225.196.144:5001/api`).

**Inventory:** There is no `/inventory` resource. Stock lives on **ProductVariant.stockQty** (Prisma). List stock via **GET /products** (and variants); change quantity via **PATCH /products/:productId/variants/:variantId/stock** with `{ "stockQty": number }` (ADMIN, MANAGER, STAFF).

**Not in this server:** HTTP routes for `/api/admin/staff` (staff is modeled in DB / seed; no staff router in `app.js`).

request.description: Redirects to Google; complete in browser or enable redirect following in Postman.

item.name: 04b - INVENTORY (ProductVariant.stockQty)
item.description: No dedicated /inventory API. Rows match Prisma `ProductVariant` (id, productId, sizeMl, sku, price, stockQty, isActive). Use GET /products to list; PATCH .../stock to adjust (ADMIN, MANAGER, STAFF).
